All classes/Tier list

Class tier list

Several creators' tier lists side by side, by kind of content — and the average of them.

Not final and subjective — every letter here is a creator's opinion from the first days of global (or from Taiwan / Korea), and balance changes from patch to patch. Pick the class you enjoy; use this to see where it shines.

trueeevilXifanGGKaidWOWKanon

PvE: dungeons and progression

What a group wants from you while learning dungeons. Healers and tanks rank high because groups need them; damage dealers are close to each other.

XifanGG flips this for late game, once groups know the fights and bosses die in 30–40 seconds: Assassin and Chanter go to S, Templar and Cleric drop to B. trueeevil puts Chanter low because groups looking for a healer want a Cleric.

Mass PvP: Abyss sieges and ZvZ

Hundreds of players around an artifact or a boss. Ranged classes and healers do the work; melee gets melted if it walks into the blob.

Kanon's list is averaged from real parses (top 25% on notmeter.com) across the latest Korean raids, Transcendence and Conquest dungeons — ranged classes lead there because they build Front Attack Damage Boost. KaidWOW ranks the damage ceiling and puts Gladiator first. Balance on global starts from scratch, so take both as a direction.

Your ping matters more than the tier

trueeevil's fourth list, and he calls it the most important one: with friends on far servers he measured up to 40% less damage on the fast weaving classes. Pick from the row that matches your ping (ms).
